qin_field_command.exception_policy: An exception is appointment-specific evidence, not a precedent. It must be explicitly persisted by the appointing authority or the exact already-issued appointment/offer that created it. It may justify that one candidate and appointment only; it never raises normal command ceilings for unrelated candidates, NPCs, Houses, or later vacancies.
qin_field_command.rule: For every Qin field-command candidate, player or NPC, ordinary offers must match demonstrated command scale rather than abstract qualification alone. A qualified candidate without verified Qin field command receives at most the registered first-command ceiling. Oversized vacancies may produce a probationary detached command drawn conservatively from the exact parent formation. Larger normal commands require completed verified Qin field service. An already-issued exceptional appointment may stand as its own exact provenance, but that exception applies only to that candidate and appointment and must never become a global scaling rule. Age is a soft ceiling rather than an absolute bar; exceptional ability may accelerate progression without erasing field-service requirements.
